description: Ask for a draft widget to go live. This requests publication; it does not publish. Called over the API or MCP with a key it does NOT publish: it creates a pending approval carrying a before/after snapshot and returns it, and the widget goes live only when a signed-in person approves it in the dashboard. The result also says where the widget will appear (`placement` — going live does not put a quiz, survey, calculator or lead magnet on any page by itself) and lists `warnings`, such as copy that promises an email no active sequence will send.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.

name: request_widget_publish
title: Request widget publish
